title: Continuing to work on my cat game!
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
My son had this idea for a laboratory level: [https://catgame.io/?level=lab](https://catgame.io/?level=lab)

**Workflow updates:**  
I've started using a cloud deployed harness that I've been working on... For the lab, I used it to generated a bunch of assets needed for the lab environment. It routes between blender, meshy, tripo etc and helps me create assets. 

Basically like an ai asset generator router: [https://gamecrew.ai/library](https://gamecrew.ai/library) (using the [MCP server](https://gamecrew.ai/developers))

Also, if you have a VR headset I've been working on a webxr port!

Overall, it is going OK, but it is extremely hard to promote. I've deployed in ios and likely will pursue steam..

Still need to polish but overall it's fun to come back and iterate on ideas. The VR mode is actually pretty incredible since the world has a more realistic feel than most VR games so it is very convincing when pushing an item off a ledge to see it smash!
